user.title: Connect to OpenNVR
user.description: Create an API token in OpenNVR under Settings > API Tokens (the Home Assistant preset has the right scopes), then enter the server's address and the token.

data_description.url: The address you open OpenNVR at, for example https://192.168.1.20
data_description.api_token: Starts with onvr_. Shown once when the token is created.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off for OpenNVR's default self-signed certificate.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.description:
Choose the cameras to add from {site}. With all of them selected, cameras added to OpenNVR later appear too.

Scopes this token lacks (the features that need them stay unavailable): {missing_scopes}

zeroconf_confirm.title: OpenNVR found
zeroconf_confirm.description: An OpenNVR server was found at {url}. Enter an API token to add it.

data_description.api_token: Create one in OpenNVR under Settings > API Tokens.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for OpenNVR's default self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {name} no longer works (revoked, expired, or missing a scope it needs). Enter a new one.

data_description.api_token: Leave blank to keep the current token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server at that address.
error.ssl_error: The server's certificate could not be verified. OpenNVR uses a self-signed certificate by default: turn off certificate verification, or install a trusted certificate.
error.invalid_auth: The token was refused (wrong, revoked or expired).
error.token_format: That is not an OpenNVR API token (they start with onvr_).
error.missing_scopes: The token lacks required scopes: {scopes}. Create a token with them in OpenNVR.
error.not_opennvr: That address did not answer like an OpenNVR server (or the server is too old to support Home Assistant).
error.unsupported_version: This OpenNVR server speaks contract version {version}, which this integration does not support. Update the integration.

abort.already_configured: This OpenNVR server is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: This OpenNVR server is already being set up.
abort.not_opennvr: The discovered service is not a usable OpenNVR server.
abort.wrong_site: That address is a different OpenNVR server than the one this entry was set up with.

data_description.cameras: With all selected, cameras added to OpenNVR later appear too.
data_description.media_ttl_hours: How long snapshot and clip links in notifications stay valid.

abort.not_loaded: The OpenNVR server must be connected to change these options.

auth_failed.message: The OpenNVR API token was refused; reauthenticate.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the OpenNVR server: {error}

unexpected.message: Unexpected reply from the OpenNVR server: {error}

unsupported_contract.message: This OpenNVR server speaks contract version {version}, which this integration does not support. Update the integration.

wrong_site.message: A different OpenNVR server answers at the configured address. Reconfigure the integration.

not_permitted.message: OpenNVR refused: the API token lacks the permission for this ({detail}).

server_too_old.message: This OpenNVR server is too old for Home Assistant. Update OpenNVR.

firewall_blocked.message: OpenNVR refuses this API token from Home Assistant's address.

token_revoked.title: OpenNVR API token no longer works

confirm.title: Enter a new API token
confirm.description: The API token for {name} was refused: it was revoked, expired, or lost a scope Home Assistant needs. Create a new token in OpenNVR under Settings > API Tokens, then continue to enter it.

abort.entry_removed: The OpenNVR entry no longer exists.

confirm.title: Replace the API token
confirm.description: The API token for {name} expires on {expires}. Create a new token in OpenNVR under Settings > API Tokens, then continue to enter it.

abort.entry_removed: The OpenNVR entry no longer exists.

firewall_blocked.title: OpenNVR refuses Home Assistant's address
firewall_blocked.description: The API token for {name} may only be used from certain addresses, and Home Assistant's is not one of them. In OpenNVR, under Settings > API Tokens, create a token whose allowed addresses include Home Assistant's (or leave them empty).

server_too_old.title: OpenNVR server too old
server_too_old.description: {name} runs OpenNVR {server} (contract {version}), which this integration cannot use. Update OpenNVR.

integration_too_old.title: OpenNVR integration too old
integration_too_old.description: {name} runs OpenNVR {server}, which speaks contract {version}. This version of the integration does not support it: update the OpenNVR integration.

webrtc_hosts_unset.title: OpenNVR live video may not reach your devices
webrtc_hosts_unset.description: OpenNVR's media server advertises no address other devices can reach, so live video over WebRTC can fail from phones and other computers. Set MEDIAMTX_WEBRTC_HOSTS to the OpenNVR host's LAN address (or open live view once in the OpenNVR web app from another device, which teaches it the address).

rtsp_not_exposed.title: OpenNVR RTSP stream not available
rtsp_not_exposed.description: Home Assistant asked {name} for an RTSP stream (used for recording clips in Home Assistant and HLS), but OpenNVR publishes RTSPS only to itself. Live view does not need it. To enable it, set RTSPS_BIND_HOST and MEDIAMTX_EXTERNAL_RTSPS_URL in OpenNVR's .env.

clock_skew.title: OpenNVR and Home Assistant clocks differ
clock_skew.description: The clocks of {name} and Home Assistant differ by {seconds} seconds. Signed links and token expiry follow OpenNVR's clock, so notifications can carry links that have already expired. Enable time synchronisation (NTP) on both machines.

ssl_unverified.title: OpenNVR certificate is not verified
ssl_unverified.description: Home Assistant connects to {name} without verifying its certificate (OpenNVR's default certificate is self-signed). Anyone who can intercept that connection could read the API token. Install a trusted certificate on OpenNVR, then reconfigure the integration with certificate verification on.
